用许多重复话，他们以为话多了必蒙垂听。
你們禱告，不可像外邦人，
用許多重複話，他們以為話多了必蒙垂聽。
In praying
don’t use vain repetitions
as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

為甚麼疑惑呢？」

took hold of him
and said to him
“You of little faith
why did you doubt?”
